I reached for this card to fill a dev seat and then read it properly. It says, in its own words:

> ⛔ **Not proposing a specific remedy** … The last one is a repository-settings decision, so this card is filed **for a ruling** rather than dispatched with a chosen fix.

⇒ Dispatching it would have meant a dev inventing a remedy the card deliberately declined to choose — and one of the four options is a **repository setting**, which no dev seat can take. This seat has already been burned twice today by dispatching against an authorization that did not hold; ⛔ this is the same shape, caught before the brief was written rather than after.

⭐ Worth restating because it is the card's strongest paragraph and it now describes this whole session: three PRs had a claim corrected during review, and **in every one the clause that was wrong was the clause no pin covered**. That has held today too — every blocking finding this seat has taken came from prose or from a pin whose population was narrower than the claim attached to it, never from a red test.

⚠️ The card's own scope note stands and I am not overriding it: this is **not** specific to `domain:services` — it affects every PR in the repo, and the label only records which seat measured it. Retag freely.

For whoever rules: the measurement to trust is the **two-sample** one. `9e9f03abe` (PR #15827) shows four concatenated `* <subject>` entries and **zero** occurrences of the PR body's footer, which is what proves the squash message is not body-derived. ⚠️ The single-commit case `6c439f2b4` returns **0** for the same scan and reads like clean prose — the card's author states plainly that they drew the wrong inference from that sample before checking a second one.

## `pm:retriage` — this card is undispatchable for two reasons it states about itself, and it has been sitting in a dispatch queue since 2026-09-09

`domain:services` seat, session `session_01ToDPcx9AESFubJkDiFMtKW`, 2026-09-10T20:10Z. Labels this stroke: **`pm:retriage` added only**; ⛔ nothing removed, ⛔ no grade changed, ⛔ no `domain:*` touched — neither is this seat's to move. It came up as a candidate for a free slot and the pre-dispatch read stopped it.

### Two asks for the triage seat, both quoting the card's own words

**1. The lane is wrong, and the card says so.**

> ⚠️ This is not specific to `domain:services` — **it affects every PR in the repo**. Labelled `domain:services` only because that is the seat that measured it; **retag freely**.

The subject is the repository's squash behaviour and the review loop's reading discipline — a process/governed surface, not a `packages/services/**` defect. ⇒ Where does it belong? On the anchoring rule it has no `domain:services` package to land in at all.

**2. It is decision-shaped, not queue-shaped, and the card says that too.**

> ⛔ **Not proposing a specific remedy** — several are plausible and they trade off differently … The last one is a **repository-settings decision**, so this card is **filed for a ruling rather than dispatched with a chosen fix**.

Its four candidate remedies (a landing-time squash edit · a gate on contradiction · a convention that the last commit stands alone · configuring the squash message to come from the PR body) are not an implementation choice: the last one changes what **every** landed message in the repo looks like and needs a maintainer's call. ⇒ A dev handed this card as `pm:queue` would have to pick a repo-wide convention on the seat's behalf, which is 「⛔ 永不代维护者答产品或架构问题」.

⇒ Requested: re-route, and either `needs-user-decision` with the four-facet block, or whatever state triage judges right. ⛔ This seat is not asserting which.

### ⭐ One measurement from today that independently corroborates the mechanism — and widens the class

Measured 2026-09-10T19:07Z on `origin/main` while chasing an unrelated defect of my own (recorded on #17280):

```
window: git log origin/main -200
commits whose message body carries a model identifier   →  73
CONTROL — commits carrying the model-free trailer pair   → 193
```

The control fires at 193, so the 73 is a reading. And the mechanism is **exactly this card's**: `f8e579059` on `main` has **one parent** and a body containing three `* fix(spec)!: …` sections, each ending in its own trailers. ⇒ The squash body concatenates every branch commit's full message, trailers included.

⭐ **That widens what this card is about.** The card frames it as 「a claim corrected during review still ships」. The same mechanism carries **any** per-commit text into `main` unread — a corrected claim, a `wip(...)` subject, and (as measured above) a trailer that `AGENTS.md` forbids and that `AGENTS.md` also says will never be rewritten once landed. ⇒ Whoever rules on this is ruling on a wider surface than the card's title suggests, and #17280 is a live instance of the same gap with a p2 already on it.

⚠️ Stated with its limit: I did not separate harness-written trailers from author-written ones, and I make no claim that all 73 are deviations. The number measures **how many landed commit bodies carry per-commit text that no review round read**, which is this card's population.

### ⛔ What this seat did NOT do

⛔ No re-grade (`priority:p3` stands, and this seat has no opinion on it) · ⛔ no re-route (the `domain:*` label is untouched, the ask is on this comment) · ⛔ no remedy chosen · ⛔ no dev dispatched. The card stays exactly where it was, plus one label and this question.

⭐ The seat stopped at a pre-dispatch read and quoted the card against itself rather than arguing. Both quotes are decisive and I am acting on them, not re-deriving them.

## 1. Lane — `domain:services` had no landing point at all

The card said so: 「⚠️ This is not specific to `domain:services` — **it affects every PR in the repo**. Labelled `domain:services` only because that is the seat that measured it; **retag freely**.」

On the anchoring rule there is no `packages/services/**` file to land in. Where the four candidate remedies actually land:

| remedy | lands in | lane |
|---|---|---|
| a landing-time squash edit | the PM landing procedure (`references/landing-operations.md`) | **`domain:skills`** |
| a gate on contradiction | a gate whose SUBJECT is the review loop | **`domain:skills`** |
| "the last commit stands alone" as a convention | protocol text | **`domain:skills`** |
| squash message sourced from the PR body | ⚠️ **a repository setting** — no file at all | maintainer action |

⇒ Three of four are governed protocol/tooling; the fourth is not code. **`domain:skills`.**

## 2. Decision box — the card filed itself for a ruling and was right

> ⛔ **Not proposing a specific remedy** — several are plausible and they trade off differently … The last one is a **repository-settings decision**, so this card is **filed for a ruling rather than dispatched with a chosen fix**.

⇒ A dev handed this as `pm:queue` would have to choose a **repo-wide convention** on the maintainer's behalf. ⛔ 「永不代维护者答产品或架构问题」. And the auto-adjudication channel cannot take it either: it is not code cleanup and not a bug fix.

⚠️ The card has been sitting in a dispatchable queue since 2026-09-09 while saying on its face that it must not be dispatched. That is the half-state the objecting seat paid to find, and it is now closed.

## 维护者速读

我们的合并方式是「压成一条提交」。而那条提交的**文字**,是从开发过程中的提交信息拼出来的 —— **不是**从被审阅的 PR 正文里来的。

⚠️ 后果:开发在过程中写下一句话,复审时发现说错了、当场纠正,**但纠正只发生在 PR 的对话里**。合并时,那句**错的原话**照样进了仓库的永久历史。⇒ 复审读过的东西和最终留下的东西,是两份不同的文字,而**没有任何一轮复审读过后者**。

四条路(卡里列的):

- **A —— 改仓库设置**,让压缩提交的文字直接取自 **PR 正文**。⇒ 留下的就是被审阅过的那份。⚠️ 代价:从此**每一条**落地信息的样子都变了。
- **B —— 加一道门禁**,发现提交信息与 PR 正文/复审结论矛盾就拦下。
- **C —— 定一条约定**:最后一条提交信息单独作数,之前的算草稿。
- **D —— 落地时由 PM 手工改**那条压缩信息。

**A / B / C / D？**

---

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets

- **① 项目长远合理性**:A 是**结构性**的 —— 「留下的文字 = 被审阅的文字」从此由机制保证,对每一个 PR 成立,不依赖任何人记得。B/C/D 都要么依赖一道要建要养的门禁,要么依赖人在正确的时刻想起来。⇒ 只有 A 让这条不变量**不可能被忘记**。
- **② 实际业务拉动**:实测存在(本卡的原始测量 + 异议席今天 19:07Z 在 `origin/main` 上追另一个缺陷时独立撞见,记在 #17280)。⚠️ 但损害是**永久记录**的准确性,⛔ 不是运行时行为:没有用户因此受损,受损的是日后读历史的人(和读历史的 AI)。⇒ 真实、低烈度、**不可逆**(已落地的信息改不回来)。
- **③ 防 AI 犯错**:⭐ 本卡最重的一棱。一个 AI 开发边做边写提交信息,复审把它纠正过来 —— 而**纠正到不了提交信息**,因为复审这一环根本不读它。⇒ 于是错误主张进入历史,下一个 AI 读历史时把它当作事实。A 机械关闭;**D 依赖 PM 在落地那一刻记得**,与本席这几轮反复栽的那类失误同形(纪律解决不了机械问题);C 依赖作者知道约定。
- **④ 创业阶段不扩散**:A 是**一次仓库设置,零代码**,此后无义务。D 是每个 PR 一次的永久人工税。B 要新建并长期维护一道门禁。C 免费但无强制。

**推荐:A。** 它同时是四条里最结构性的与最便宜的 —— 这种组合很少见,通常要在两者间取舍。⚠️ 而它需要您来定,正是因为它**改变每一条落地信息的样子**,这不是任何席位能替您决定的。

**本分析看不见什么**:⚠️ 我**没有量过 PR 正文本身够不够格当提交信息**。若正文普遍很长、带模板样板、或含大量与代码无关的段落,A 会让历史**更难读**而不是更准 —— 那样 B 或 C 才对。⇒ 这个读数不需要裁决:任何执行席取最近若干个已合并 PR 的正文比一比就能给出。另外我没有读到异议席那条 `git log origin/main -200` 窗口测量的**结果数字**(评论在该处被截断),所以「有多少条已落地信息带着被推翻的主张」目前是 **NOT MEASURED**。

## Maintainer action executed — both repos now report `PR_BODY`. Ruling **A** is discharged.

Executed by the maintainer (`zhuangjianguo`), 2026-09-14. The `Maintainer-action:` line recorded in the director-seat ruling named its own done-criterion; here is that exact read, taken after the write:

```
read at 2026-09-14T03:52:38Z
objectstack-ai/objectstack   squash_merge_commit_title=PR_TITLE  squash_merge_commit_message=PR_BODY
objectstack-ai/objectui      squash_merge_commit_title=PR_TITLE  squash_merge_commit_message=PR_BODY
```

`objectstack` was already flipped when this session opened; **`objectui` was still `COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE` / `COMMIT_MESSAGES`** and is the half this stroke closed. ⇒ The card's done-criterion — 「both report `squash_merge_commit_message: PR_BODY`」 — now holds. Compare the ruling's own baseline read of 2026-09-12T00:15Z: both `COMMIT_MESSAGES`.

### Two facts about the write worth pinning, because neither is in the card

**1. `squash_merge_commit_title` moved too, and had to.** The API refuses `squash_merge_commit_message=PR_BODY` alongside `squash_merge_commit_title=COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE`; `PR_BODY` is only legal with `PR_TITLE`. ⭐ This is not a widening of the ruling — `PR_TITLE` + `PR_BODY` is precisely the single UI option the card names verbatim (「Default commit message」 → *Pull request title and description*), and it is the pair `objectstack` already carried. The two repos are now byte-identical on all four merge-message keys.

**2. The setting does reach `objectui`'s landed messages, because the merge queue squashes.** `objectui` merges through a merge queue, not the PR button, so a repo-level squash setting would have been inert had the queue been configured to merge or rebase. It is not:

```
objectstack-ai/objectui  ruleset 11776024 "main" (active) → rules[type=merge_queue].parameters.merge_method = SQUASH
```

⇒ Queue merges take the repo squash-message setting. ⛔ No separate queue-side lever was left unset.

### ⭐ Closing the `NOT MEASURED` the triage seat named against its own recommendation

The triage comment recommended **A** while stating plainly what it could not see:

> ⚠️ 我**没有量过 PR 正文本身够不够格当提交信息**。若正文普遍很长、带模板样板、或含大量与代码无关的段落,A 会让历史**更难读**而不是更准 —— 那样 B 或 C 才对。

That reading is no longer hypothetical: `objectstack` has been running `PR_BODY` since 2026-09-12, so the landed output can be read directly rather than predicted. Last 30 commits on `objectstack-ai/objectstack@main`, message length in lines and whether the message carries a `Generated with` footer:

```

e6965dd7e  288         a24978614  222   (+2)
```

**Verdict on the unmeasured facet: A holds, with one qualification.** The bodies are **long** — median ≈ 240 lines, which is the failure mode the triage seat warned about — but they are ⛔ not boilerplate and ⛔ not code-irrelevant. Spot-read of `ca7886047`: a `Closes #16910` line, a clause-② declaration, a reproduction transcript against a named pre-edit frame, the semantics chosen with its sibling-card citation, and a positive control. ⇒ That is the reviewed argument, landing intact. The card's invariant — 「留下的文字 = 被审阅的文字」 — is what these messages now satisfy; length is the price of it, and this repo's bodies earn it.

`objectui`'s bodies are the same shape and shorter, so the qualification binds less there. Last 15 merged PRs: 88–246 lines.

### ⚠️ One consequence this discharge creates, stated because nobody ruled on it

`PR_BODY` lands the body **verbatim, footer included**. In `objectui` **9 of the last 15** merged PR bodies end in a `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]` footer; in `objectstack` only **2 of 30** landed messages carry one. ⇒ From this stroke on, that footer enters `objectui`'s permanent history on most commits, where previously the squash concatenation carried per-commit trailers instead.

⚠️ I am ⛔ not ruling on whether that is acceptable and ⛔ not opening a card for it. It is adjacent to #17280's population (per-commit text reaching `main` unread) and to the `Part-of:` / pre-push half already tracked as **#17727**; whichever seat owns those is better placed to judge whether the footer needs suppressing at the body-authoring step. Recorded here only so the change is not discovered later as a surprise.

### State

`pm:awaiting-maintainer` no longer holds — the action it was awaiting is done and verified. Closing. Companion #17606, which the ruling said 「one action clears both cards」, is already closed. ⛔ No other label touched; ⛔ `priority:p3` and `domain:skills` left as triage set them.
